title: 生涯スポーツ演習(トレーニング)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports (Training)
courseType:
Humanities and Social Sciences Program
Liberal Arts and Sciences Courses
Lifelong Sports
keywords: Fitness improvement 2.Health promotion 3.Muscular training 4.Endurance training 5.Shape-up training
educationalGoal: Through learning activities for golf, students will: 1)Understand the pleasure derived from sports. 2)Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle. 3)Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: Based on the knowledge of training science learned in "Introduction to Fitness and Health Promotion", students will train at least once a week using training facilities. In addition, students will analyze the difference between the results of physical fitness evaluations in January and April. All students should warm up and exercise according to their own program. Students should one or two different kinds of training shown below: 1. Muscular training 2. Endurance training 3. Shape-up training At the end of the course, students will analyze the effects of their training. Other: Students will take an interview test when they submit the first report. If students do not understand training principles sufficiently, they will not be permitted to train. Students should be prepared with the appropriate clothing, indoor shoes, and a towel to engage in training from autumn to winter. Students should pay attention to their own health condition to train safely. In the case of a poor physical condition, students should not train.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of training science learned in “Introduction to Fitness and Health promotion”. Students have to train at least 10 times, including a trial training program, and undergo two physical fitness evaluations. Understanding about safety management in sports activities.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for training and use them in learning activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in learning activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime.(2) Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them fully in class activities.(3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle.(4) Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.(5) Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits.(6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime.(2) Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them roughly in class activities.(3)Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle.(4)Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities.(5)Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits.(6)Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.
